visualReview.notes: Inspected all 12 current portable frames: full exterior, four turns, main vault, pointed relief windows, soffit, humped cobbled walkway, bent western approach, eastern arch sequence and close masonry. The thirteen openings remain unobstructed and the main vault has two raised stone bands.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all 12 current shared-surface/sky-PMREM frames, including north-up placement. Canonical dry-stone and granite graphs are shared; individual cobbles, arch stones, step courses and low parapets remain visible. Actual regional loading and resource unload assertions pass.

geographicReview.notes: Horizontal placement is reviewed: exact Q856285 centerline, signed east-northeast +X, south-southeast +Z toward the separate modern bridge, published 3.4 m transverse width. The native support bases climb from riverbed Y0 to bank levels; flat review terrain leaves the bank supports suspended. Actual local rocky-bank terrain fit still needs verification before full placement approval.

fidelityReview.notes: 334,084-triangle original exterior reconstruction with thirteen unequal openings, published 21.5 m main clear span and paired arch bands, three raised pointed relief windows, fully open stone vaults, humped bent deck, individually faceted and varied cobbles, raised edge-set step courses, articulated masonry and low capped parapets. Main dimensions and arch sequence use the regional heritage record, IKTK site-sign plan and original 2017/2025 photographs. Minor arch stations, elevations and stone arrangement are photographic reconstruction. Surrounding bedrock and the separate modern road bridge are not embedded.
